data_origin: COMPLETELY SYNTHETIC. All DGP parameters invented here, not estimated from patients or copied from clinical papers. No personal data.
intended_use: Research-only demonstration of evaluation and recalibration of a fixed binary classifier under invented site shifts; no disease, patient, clinical decision or treatment target.
population: Independent synthetic rows from three expressly invented Gaussian/Bernoulli DGPs. Site is a simulation scenario, not a hospital.
index_time: Synthetic row generation; no follow-up time, censoring or prognostic horizon.
outcome_reference: y is Bernoulli(p_true) from the declared DGP; ground truth is the random draw, with p_true available as simulation oracle only.
predictors: x1,x2 independent standard normal; observed x1 may be multiplied by a site-specific scale; x2 may be MCAR missing and imputed to zero. No fitted imputer.
clinical_decision_point: NONE. Toy threshold arithmetic has no clinical utility interpretation.
rng: numpy.random.default_rng(numpy.random.SeedSequence([seed,site_index,split_index])); site order A_reference,B_intercept,C_measurement; split calibration=0,evaluation=1; draw x1 normal, x2 normal, missing uniforms, label uniforms in that order.
dgp: p_true = sigmoid(outcome_intercept + x1 - 0.5*x2); y = (u_label < p_true); missing = (u_missing < missing_probability); observed_x1=x1_scale*x1; observed_x2=0 if missing else x2.

fixed_model.training: NONE. Coefficients fixed by design; not trained or selected on any data.

recalibration: For each seed/site separately, fit logistic y ~ alpha + beta*fixed_logit using calibration rows ONLY, unpenalized Newton maximum likelihood, start [0,1], maximum 100 iterations, step infinity norm tolerance 1e-10; clip linear predictors to [-35,35] for sigmoid numerical safety. No hyperparameter selection or external model retraining. Updated model results must be labelled separately.
splits: Independent RNG streams and unique row IDs across seed/site/split. Evaluation rows never fit calibrator. Source A is an in-DGP synthetic reference; B/C are synthetic shifted scenarios, never genuine clinical external validation.
primary_estimand: For each site, mean over five independent repetitions of held-out empirical Brier(recalibrated) minus Brier(fixed), averaging equally over seeds. Negative is lower Brier. Report all 15 paired values, five-seed mean, Monte Carlo standard error and two-sided t(4) 95% interval. No multiplicity-adjusted inference or success claim.
secondary_metrics: AUPRC defined as non-interpolated average precision with equal-score groups
joint logistic calibration intercept and slope on evaluation rows, descriptive ONLY and never applied back to predictions
10 equal-width-bin reliability counts and mean predictions/outcomes
toy net benefit TP/n - FP/n*t/(1-t) for t=0.2,0.5,0.8, plus select-all/select-none comparators
subgroups x1<0 and x1>=0: per-run Brier and paired Brier difference with conditional normal 95% intervals; also seed-level t(4) intervals for subgroup differences
uncertainty_limits: Only five repetitions; t intervals are rough Monte Carlo summaries under invented DGP, not clinical confidence or transport guarantees. Conditional row-level subgroup intervals ignore calibration-set variability; aggregate repeated-seed intervals incorporate it approximately. AUROC/AP/calibration coefficient intervals NOT_RUN.
hypotheses: B_intercept recalibration is expected to lower held-out Brier on average, but the observed sign is not an acceptance criterion.
A_reference recalibration can worsen Brier because of finite calibration sample.
C_measurement recalibration cannot recover lost information; compare oracle p_true discrimination/Brier as a diagnostic upper-information reference.
evaluator: Author implementation in run_baseline.py. Independent coordinator will check using a distinct implementation and raw CSVs, including direct paired Brier and rank-based metrics. Evaluator cannot be weakened after outputs are inspected.
required_controls: Tied p=.5 on balanced labels: AUROC=.5, AP=.5.
Flipped labels on ordered fixture must yield AUROC=0, Brier=.725.
Reject duplicate calibration/evaluation row ID before fitting.
Reject a flipped label against sealed row-data SHA256 manifest.
Reject changed fixed model coefficients against frozen model SHA256.
acceptance: All finite test metrics and split sizes reported for every scheduled seed/site; known positives exact within 1e-12; leakage, label and model tampering rejected; re-run deterministic outputs; all failures and negative comparisons retained. No scientific improvement threshold. Governance record passes at pinned revision. Independent result verification required before any verified claim.
not_run: large Monte Carlo or sample-size adequacy study
